name: OpenID Connect
extra_settings: One app per OIDC server under APPS, each with provider_id, name, client_id, secret

icon.note: OpenID Foundation logo, also used for OpenID Connect; Lucide KeyRound is a neutral alternative.

name: SAML
extra_settings: Needs the saml extra: pip install "django-allauth[saml]" (plus xmlsec system packages)
One app per organization: client_id is the organization slug, provider_id should be the IdP entity ID

settings.attribute_mapping for uid, email, email_verified
Optional settings.sp.entity_id, settings.advanced (signing, encryption, private_key, x509cert), contact_person
Endpoints: /accounts/saml/<organization_slug>/login/, acs/, sls/, metadata/

icon.note: Protocol, no brand icon.

notes: Install the saml extra, add one APPS entry per organization with its IdP entity ID and metadata URL (or SSO URL and certificate), map attributes, and give the IdP the ACS and metadata URLs.
